title: PDF to page images
html:
01 Render: PDF to page images

One image per PDF page, 2,000 px on the long side, greyscale PNG. seq-NNNN.png is PDF page N, counting from 0.

uv run render_pages.py BOOK.pdf -o 01_render/out --first 0 --long-side 2000

Result: 4,310 images, 1.03 GB, 8 min 45 s. The images are not in git (rebuild them from the PDF); manifest.json holds one checksum over all file names and file hashes.

Manifest

Run at . A checksum (sha256) names the exact file a step read or wrote.

inputs (1)

{"path": "明孝宗實錄 PDF", "pages": 4310, "sha256_prefix": "dcf25596040c084b"}

outputs (1)

01_render/out1,025,179,592

numbers

{
 "pages": 4310,
 "long_side_px": 2000,
 "render_seconds": 525
}

Output

4,310 page images. They are not on this site. The text read from each one is: start at the first page of 卷一.
